prompt: We ___ (visit) my grandparents last weekend.
She ___ (not / come) to the meeting yesterday.
___ (you / see) the film on Saturday?
The concert ___ (start) two hours late.
They bought a new car in 2019.
solution: They didn't buy a new car in 2019.
explanation: Tras didn't el verbo vuelve al infinitivo: didn't buy, no didn't bought.

prompt: You called her last night.
solution: Did you call her last night?
explanation: Did + sujeto + infinitivo: el pasado lo marca did, no el verbo principal.

prompt: I finished the report two days ago.
explanation: two days ago es un momento cerrado del pasado, y eso pide Past Simple.

prompt: When I was a child, I lived in a small village.
explanation: when I was a child sitúa la acción en un pasado terminado: Past Simple.

prompt: They ___ (not / be) at home when I called.
___ (she / study) medicine when she was younger?
Did you find the keys that morning?
solution: You found the keys that morning.
explanation: En afirmativa desaparece did y el pasado lo marca el verbo: found.

prompt: We have lived in this town since 2015.
explanation: since abre un periodo que sigue abierto: eso pide present perfect, no past simple.
